Frequently Asked Questions

What is a split journey in Indian Railways?
A split journey divides a travel route into two connecting legs (either within the same train across different station quotas or across two coordinating trains) to find available seats when origin-to-destination direct tickets are waitlisted.
What is AI Split Journey?
AI Split Journey is our proprietary algorithm that breaks your trip into two parts if a direct train is waitlisted, finding alternate combinations for both legs.
How does Trayago find alternative tickets?
We scan the entire IRCTC network's quota system to find hidden stations where seats are still available, even when your boarding station shows WL.
Is booking split tickets allowed under railway reservation rules?
Yes, booking individual valid tickets for each leg of a train journey is fully permissible under Indian Railways rules, provided every ticket is booked through authorized booking channels.
Is AI Split Journey safe?
Yes, you travel on the same train or a secure connection, holding two valid IRCTC tickets for your journey.
How does Trayago calculate PNR confirmation probability?
Trayago evaluates historical confirmation patterns, waitlist types (such as GNWL, RLWL, and PQWL), and seasonal travel demand to provide an estimated probability of confirmation before final chart preparation.
How accurate is PNR Prediction?
Our PNR prediction uses historical data and machine learning to achieve an accuracy rate of over 92%.
Can I track live train delays and station arrival times on Trayago?
Yes, you can check real-time running status, current train location, delays, and expected platform arrivals by entering any 5-digit Indian Railways train number on the Live Status tool.
Is Trayago affiliated with IRCTC?
No. Trayago is an independent travel intelligence platform and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by IRCTC or Indian Railways.
Does Trayago issue railway tickets?
No. Trayago provides AI-powered route recommendations and journey intelligence only. Ticket booking is completed through official booking platforms.
Does Trayago guarantee confirmed tickets?
No. Trayago provides AI-powered route recommendations to improve your chances of finding availability, but cannot guarantee confirmed tickets.
Do I need to pay before searching?
Basic searches are free. You only need to upgrade if you want to use advanced AI Split routing extensively.
Why is Trayago different?
We don't just show you waitlists. We actively compute alternative ways to get you to your destination using advanced graph algorithms.
Is my data secure?
Absolutely. We do not store your payment information, and your PNR details are securely hashed and anonymized.

Split Journey Engine: Alternative Routes When Direct Trains Are Full

When direct trains from your origin to destination are sold out or show long waitlists, Trayago’s Split Journey Engine analyzes intermediate stations and network junctions to find confirmed booking segments. By evaluating same-train station quota splits (such as booking across different booking legs on the same train) or coordinated two-train connections with safe transfer buffers, travelers can discover confirmed travel options across the Indian Railways network.

Each route suggestion details departure and arrival timings, layover duration at connecting hubs, and real-time class availability across Sleeper (SL), 3rd AC (3A), 2nd AC (2A), and 1st AC (1A).

PNR Status Tracking & Waitlist Confirmation Analysis

Track your 10-digit Indian Railways PNR number with real-time updates. Trayago provides booking status versus current status, assigned coach and berth positions upon chart preparation, and data-driven confirmation probability analysis.

Our confirmation estimates evaluate historical booking trends, quota categories (including GNWL, RLWL, and PQWL), and seasonal demand patterns to give passengers transparent visibility into their waitlist progression.

Live Train Running Status & Railway Travel Tools

Stay updated throughout your trip with Trayago’s railway utility tools. Check live train running status with real-time GPS delays, upcoming station arrival estimates, and platform number indicators.

You can also inspect complete train schedules with intermediate halt durations, check daily Indian Railways train cancellations, and access onboard assistance links.
